findings.title: [P1] Restore the `RequestOptions` export deleted from types.ts
findings.body: `src/types.ts` deletes `export interface RequestOptions { timeoutMs: number }`, but `src/client.ts:1` still does `import { RequestOptions, ClientOptions } from "./types"` and `src/client.ts:3` uses `RequestOptions` as the parameter type of `request()`, whose body reads `options.timeoutMs`. Since `./types` no longer exports that member, any TypeScript compile/type-check of this project fails with TS2305 ("Module '"./types"' has no exported member 'RequestOptions'"), and external consumers importing the previously exported contract break the same way. Restore the interface (or replace it with a compatible exported definition) before merge; if removal is intentional, `client.ts` must stop importing and referencing it in the same change.

findings.title: [nit] Remove the unused `ClientOptions` import in client.ts
findings.body: The import line was changed to add `ClientOptions`, but nothing in `client.ts` references it — the only occurrence is the import itself. It adds no value and becomes a hard error under `noUnusedLocals` or an unused-imports lint rule. Drop it (or use it if a wider refactor was intended).
